RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 60

An all-male panel is not definitive proof of discrimination on its own, but combined with your significantly stronger formal leadership qualifications and their delayed response, it serves as a credible red flag for potential implicit bias. 

Whether to raise it depends on your immediate goal and local legal protections. Do not lead with bias accusations right away. First, formally press for the written explanation, citing any relevant hiring policies or statutory rights to feedback. If their justification appears pretextual or fails to account for leadership criteria, consult a union representative or legal counsel to determine whether to cite panel composition and disparate qualifications in a formal discrimination grievance.
